scope: Two isolated profiles; RC16-derived FinalLocalCandidate20 reduced-trio package at desktop1440x900 and mobile-sized390x844 with touch emulation. Ten30-second controlled encounter runs each, twice-interrupted attacks, actual pause/dialogue ticks, existing fastTravel flow, keyboard movement/focus reset, actual save and same-profile browser reload/continue. Ten minutes total accelerated encounter simulation, not a wall-clock playthrough. No user save, physical phone or controller access.
